scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 File Storage 操作场景：创建存储账户 → 创建文件共享 → 上传文件 → 列出共享 → 删除
commands: az storage account create --name teststorage --resource-group test-rg --sku Standard_LRS
az storage share create --name test-share --account-name teststorage
az storage file upload --share-name test-share --source /tmp/test.txt --account-name teststorage
az storage account delete --name teststorage --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：存储账户创建成功但文件上传失败
commands: az storage account create --name failstorage --resource-group test-rg --sku Standard_LRS
az storage file upload --share-name nonexistent-share --source /tmp/test.txt --account-name failstorage

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：存储账户不存在
commands: az storage account show --name nonexistent-storage --resource-group test-rg
